name: What steps should I take before scheduling bathroom drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What steps should I take before scheduling bathroom drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before repair work begins, find and eliminate the underlying source of moisture, whether it is a leaking pipe, failing shower grout, or inadequate ventilation. Check for squishy wall surfaces, peeling paint, or musty smells, and clear out personal items, toiletries, and vanity contents around the repair area. Taking clear photos of active leaks or discoloration before starting also helps document issues if you are filing a homeowner insurance claim for pipe breaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify and fix the plumbing leak or moisture source first, clear your bathroom countertops and cabinets near the damage, and document any water issues with photos.
